[[Module:Characters/doc|Documentation]]

This module is powered by [[Module:Characters/characters.json]].

== JSON structure ==
The backing JSON file is a dictionary with character names for keys. The structure is roughly as shown below, with an addendum that isn't perfectly represented in the auto-generated structure below: virtually any "scalar" field (string, boolean, etc) can be replaced with a table that contains a field of the same name and a field named "refs" pointing to an array of references.

Copying this is a good starting point for entering a new character in the database. Delete any irrelevant keys (e.g. delete the "white_tower" key for characters who aren't Tower initiates.)

{{#invoke:Characters|get_json_structure}}
